notes.title: Release Date + FINAL DEMO!
notes.notes:
🎉 Ladies and Gentlemen, we finally have a release date! 🎉

The release of Vesper is right around the corner - July 30th, to be exact! We have been putting in a lot of hard work into polishing the game and creating a new and improved demo and we're super exicted for people to soon get their hands on our love letter to the genre of puzzle-platformers! We're sure that especially fans of a more old-school approach will love this game! 

So after you took a look at our release date trailer, why not give the new (and FINAL) demo version a spin? We tried to show off as many of the games' mechanics as we could (without spoiling anything of course) and even players who completed our previous demo before might be surprised! There's not only some never shown before new content, but tons and TONS of further improvements all-around! 

...and for our story-focused players: we might have hidden some small new lore bits as well 👀

Not much longer and we can finally fully show off what we've been working on over those last years. We sincerely hope you'll like what we've created and please let us know what you think of the demo - either on the Steam forums or our community Discord ( https://discord.gg/DRvqbZzaFJ )!

❤ Thank you so much! ❤

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hi humans!

We are releasing a small patch to address the most common issues some of you are experiencing with the Demo.

Thank you for everyone that played it in the last few days and took some time to provide feedback.
Here's is a short list of what changes with the new patch:


 Fixed issue with final cutscene not showing up correctly.
 Fixed compatibility with screen aspect ratios different from 16:9.
 Added checkpoint to last part of the demo to prevent frustration from dying because of a Sentinel.
 Other minor fixes.


As always, if you like the game, please consider adding it to your wishlist!

Until next time,
Tom
